title: J.A.R.V.I.S: an Iron Man-style voice HUD for Claude
summary: A JARVIS/Batcomputer-style dashboard for your Mac. Talk or type, and Claude Code does the work with full tool access. Push-to-talk with local Whisper, spoken replies, a live arc-reactor orb and system readouts.
how_to_use: node server.js, then open http://localhost:1963. Read README.md first: it runs Claude with permissions skipped, so keep it local only.
requires: macOS, Node, Claude Code CLI, whisper.cpp + a model (not included, see README), edge-tts.
